transcript.statement: The EfficiencyAgent emphasizes the importance of optimizing performance efficiency in the autonomous driving system. Requirements EFF-01 and EFF-05 focus on reducing travel time and ensuring high success rates in speed profile generation, which are crucial for user satisfaction and system effectiveness. EFF-02 and EFF-07 prioritize maintaining low jerk values and smooth transitions, even during emergencies, to enhance passenger comfort. However, I raise concerns regarding SAF-02 and RES-06, as the emphasis on Minimal Risk Maneuvers may conflict with the need for speed and smoothness, potentially leading to performance degradation.

transcript.statement: The SafetyAgent emphasizes the critical importance of safety and reliability in the autonomous driving system. requirements.text: The system shall implement a multi-layer safety architecture including passive, active, and functional safety mechanisms to ensure collision protection and fail-safe operations.
The system shall execute a Minimal Risk Maneuver within a controlled time frame upon detecting critical failures, ensuring safety while accommodating smoother transitions.
The system shall continuously monitor Operational Design Domain compliance and issue a human takeover request when boundaries are approached.
The system shall minimize jerk to less than 0.5 m/s³ during normal operations while allowing a controlled increase during emergencies.
The system shall satisfy curvature constraints ($kappa$) to prevent rollover during maneuvers at all speeds.
The system shall utilize iterative quadratic programming to handle non-convex obstacle constraints reliably within a response time of 100 milliseconds.
The system shall optimize path planning to achieve a minimum 30% reduction in average travel time while integrating safety and energy efficiency metrics.
The system shall maintain a jerk value below 0.5 m/s³ during normal operation to enhance passenger comfort.
The system shall achieve at least 95% success rate in optimal speed profile generation during path planning, incorporating security assessments.
The system shall implement end-to-end data encryption for all user data transmitted to protect privacy and ensure data integrity.
The system shall enforce role-based access control to restrict user permissions based on their role within the system.
The system shall log all access and modifications to critical data for auditability purposes.
The system shall conduct regular security audits at least bi-annually to identify and mitigate potential vulnerabilities.
The system shall ensure compliance with the Apollo Pilot Safety Report and EM Motion Planner specifications at all operational times.
The system shall document all safety and compliance-related decisions and changes for accountability and regulatory purposes.
